text.p: (Millions of constant pesos as of June 30, 1997;

NOTES: (1) Percent change with respect to the same period last year (2) Interest paid for the first half and second quarter diminished 34.4 percent and 35.8 percent, respectively. (3) Includes a non-cash charge of Ps. $680 million due to the goodwill write-off made by Grupo Financiero Serfin in June, 1997 (4) Includes a gain of Ps. $504 million from the sale of the raw material sector. (5) Tax benefit from the amortization of tax losses carried forward.

(6) Not applicable; net losses in 1996 of Ps. $384.5 million and Ps. $918.1 million, for the first half and the second quarter of 1996, respectively. (7) Not applicable, net losses in 1996 of Ps. $596.9 million and Ps. $1,027.1 million for the first half and the second quarter of 1996, respectively. (8) Using 360 million shares.

Consolidated sales for Q2 1997 were $4.9 billion pesos, a 5.4 percent increase from the $4.6 billion pesos recorded last year. Export sales were US $168.3 million, up 11.6 percent. Operating income for the period was $950 million pesos, up 17.4 percent from the $808.8 million pesos reported last year.

Net income of majority interest was $196 million pesos for the second quarter versus a loss of ($1.03) billion pesos last year. Net income for the current period reflects a net charge of $176 million pesos as a result of some non-cash and non-recurring items as explained above.
